amendments.reason: The search reference documents project search as GET /projects/:id/search; the pinned document writes the route with GitLab's (-/) notation for an optional segment, which read as a template would send the parentheses literally.

The commits reference documents a commit as a posted JSON payload of branch, commit_message and an actions array; the pinned document declares the body only as multipart/form-data holding one binary file, which no form of that request carries.
The repository files reference documents the update as a JSON body of branch, content and commit_message; the pinned document declares the body only as multipart/form-data holding one binary file.
The projects reference documents project creation with a JSON body (Content-Type application/json); the pinned document declares the body only as multipart/form-data.
